_source: HEDB Data Dictionary 202601, sheet 'Institute - Academic Programs'
_note: Rebuilt 2026-10-27 against Zoho_To_CHEDS_ (34).ds. HEDB 202601 fills a removed field's row red: 13 fields were struck on this sheet (Major CIP Code, STEM indicator, Accredited by CAA, CAA Initial Accreditation Date, First-enrollment Year, Program Level/Degree, Area of Specialization, Number of Students, Program Faculty Members, Adjunct Faculty Members, Coordinator Email, Coordinator Mobile, Distance Learning indicator) and are omitted here; the Zoho form and push payload already drop them too. Prog_Program_Name is NEW in 202601 and carried as reference-only. raw_column values are the dictionary's 'Database Field Name' column verbatim.

fields._note: Raw HEDB code is converted to its descriptive Name using the 'Institutional Codes' reference list -- the Zoho lookup displays [Name] and is filtered to Code == "141". (Previously 'plain', which wrote the bare code 141 into a field whose dropdown shows the institution NAME, so the lookup never resolved on import.)
Reference only -- the Zoho form derives the name from the Institution code lookup, so no column is written.

Raw HEDB academic-year code (e.g. 202526) is converted to a combined 'Name - Code' display value using the 'Academic Year' reference list, because the Zoho lookup displays [Name + " - " + Code]. (Previously 'code_to_name', which produced only the name and so never matched the dropdown.) The push sends rec.Academic_Year.Code.

Reference only -- NEW column in HEDB 202601. The Zoho 'Program Name' field is a lookup into Program_Code displaying [Name + " - " + Code], so it cannot be filled from the raw name text alone; it is resolved from Prog_Program_Code instead (next entry). The push sends rec.Program_Name.Name, which is what CHEDS receives as programName.

Raw CAA Program Code is converted to a combined 'Name - Code' display value using the 'Program Master' reference list, because the Zoho lookup displays [Name + " - " + Code]. (Previously 'code_to_name', which produced only the program name and so never matched the dropdown.)
No conversion -- this Zoho lookup displays [Code] only, so the raw CAA Program Code is already the exact display value. The same raw column also feeds Program_Name above.
No conversion applied -- value is imported exactly as provided in the raw file.
No conversion applied -- value is imported exactly as provided in the raw file.
Raw 'Y'/'N' indicator is converted to the exact Zoho picklist text: 'Y' -> 'Yes'; 'N' -> 'No'. The push sends .subString(0,1) to recover the code.

No conversion. CHEDS requires this when Joint/Dual degree program is 'Y'. NOTE: the push does NOT send this field -- it sends rec.Code_of_the_partner_university.Name for the nameOfThePartnerUniversity key, so the ministry receives the name from the Universities list rather than this free-text value.
Raw 2-letter nation code is converted to its descriptive Name using the 'Country' reference list; the Zoho lookup displays [Name] and the push sends .Code back.
Raw CHEDS University Code is converted to its descriptive Name using the 'Universities' reference list; the Zoho lookup displays [Name] and the push sends both .Code and .Name.

Raw HEDB academic-year code is converted to its descriptive Name using the 'Academic Year' reference list. This lookup displays [Name] only -- unlike Academic_Year above, which displays Name and Code.
No conversion applied -- value is imported exactly as provided in the raw file.
No conversion -- number with up to two decimal places.
No conversion -- number with up to two decimal places.
No conversion -- number with up to two decimal places.
Raw 'Y'/'N' indicator is converted to the exact Zoho picklist text: 'Y' -> 'Yes'; 'N' -> 'No'. The push sends .subString(0,1) to recover the code.
Raw 'Y'/'N' indicator is converted to the exact Zoho picklist text: 'Y' -> 'Yes'; 'N' -> 'No'. The push sends .subString(0,1) to recover the code.
HEDB specifies 'YYYY-MM' (month precision). The Zoho field is a Date, and the push re-formats it with .toString("yyyy-MM"), so any day component is harmless but the time portion is stripped here.
No conversion applied -- value is imported exactly as provided in the raw file.
HEDB specifies 'YYYY-MM' (month precision). The push re-formats with .toString("yyyy-MM").

value_map.T: T - For thesis based graduate programs
value_map.D: D - Post-grad programs for which both professional and thesis options are available
